name: Rob LaBelle
bio: Rob LaBelle (born 2 August 1962, Minneapolis, Minnesota) is an American actor, producer, and director. He is best known as Crazy Eddie in First Wave (1998–2001) and for roles in Watchmen (2009), What's Love Got to Do With It (1993), and recurring parts on Smallville, Supernatural, and Star Trek: Voyager. He is a dual US–Canadian citizen living in Vancouver, BC, and is the father of actor Gabriel LaBelle.
